strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Whew... Looks like we've finally reached an area big enough to deploy.
Are the residents safe?
The shelter blocks we saw on the way here looked intact...
Oh right, what about Domon's old man, who got ejected?
We recovered him. And the shelters should be able to eject from it.
I'm accessing that secret circuit now.
Looks like we can cut loose without worrying.
We've come this far. We'll just go as far as we can!
Now, let's defeat the Devil Gundam!
Welcome, members of Londo Bell.
That's him... the man behind the whole Devil Gundam affair...
A former Gundam Fighter, and a Neo Japan major...
...Ulube!
I'll at least praise you for making it this far.
However, that too...
Shut up! Just give Rain back and that's that. Otherwise...
Otherwise...?
Ohh......? So you're the prince come to rescue the captive princess.
And I am the wicked wizard standing in your way... is that it?
Wow! He's using the exact metaphor the Captain did!
But he sure doesn't look like he plans to give the princess back...!
That man... has no openings...
Heh heh heh, cease your futile efforts. All resistance is meaningless!
Now, with the Devil Gundam's vast power, the Earth Sphere will be mine!
Like we'd fall for that lie!
Dr. Mikamura told us it can be beaten from the inside!
That's right! You can't know if it's futile until you try!
But... the inside of the colony isn't much different from the outside...
Will it really work...?
Don't go soft! We've gotta do it!
...That's right. Even it isn't immortal. The Devil Gundam can be defeated...
by our human hands.
Dr. Kasshu!
Dr. Kasshu, you've only just woken from cryo-sleep...
Please don't push yourself...
I'm afraid I can't afford not to... Domon...! Can you hear me, Domon!?
Father...? You're awake!? Father!
I've heard the gist. Listen, the colony's main reactor powers him...
Shut it down. That's the only way!
The reactor...?
The Neo Japan colony seems to have centralized its internal energy supply
in the main reactor...
You could call it the colony's heart.
I see. If we strike the colony's heart...
we should be able to stop the Devil Gundam leeching off it too.
Understood, Father...!
All right, so the reactor's the target...!
...Domon.
You've grown... grown so much...
Father... Yeah. I'm off...!
Damn you, Dr. Kasshu! Meddling fool.
...No helping it. Heh heh heh... I'll enjoy a Gundam Fight myself, for once...
I've kept this body trained for just such an occasion! Nuuuuuh!
Wh-What!?
Major Ulube is raring to go.
Also... a high energy reading from underground... incoming.
And if my opponent is Londo Bell, I couldn't ask for better!
Now come forth, my limbs! Grand Master Gundam!
What!? That's...
Hm...! What...?
The machine he boarded... Is part of the facility transforming...?
Come at me! This invincible main reactor will be your opponent!
Th-This thing... is the reactor!?
The reactor itself seems to have turned into a giant
Mobile Fighter...
Tch! So our enemy's that big lug itself, eh?
This is... the Devil Gundam's final form...!?
Wrong! My name is Grand Master Gundam!
Now, come at me!
Who cares! The reactor we were looking for came out to us on its own!
Saves us the trouble of searching!
Yeah, if we smash him, we can restore this colony, right!?
Shinobu, take him out!
Hear me! You foolish insects!
The great DG Cells grant us infinite power!
Behold! Thanks to them, I've become ruler of the world!
Yes, from now on it's the age of DG Cells! Let humanity perish!
What? That man's face...
Wh-What the...!? Is that a human!?
Seems he's infected by DG Cells too... Though I suppose he wanted it...
He's lost his mind...
I get what his ambition is... but I won't forgive tearing lovers apart!
All right, all units, attack!
Target: the main reactor... the Grand Master Gundam!
Hang on... Rain!
Gwaaah!
Did you get him, Domon!?
...No, wait.
Heh... Heh heh... Hahahahahahaha!
Why won't it blow up!?
Impossible! We definitely beat him, and he's the reactor!
Wh-What is this!? So it was already too late...
Dr. Kasshu......?
If it's come to this, there's only one option left...
We have to stop Rain, the bio-unit...!
Stop Rain...? You don't mean... kill her!?
Nonsense! ...After coming this far, how can I give up!?
I won't hand Rain over to anyone... I won't let you have her!!
Heh heh... It's no use... Rain will never... return... to... you......
Did I do it!? Raiiiin!!
...Ugh... D-Domon...?
Rain! Raiin! ...I'm sorry...
...No... Domon... I'm the one who should... apologize.
Thank goodness... Rain, you're safe...
Hurry! It's going to blow!
Come on, let's get back to the ship...
Okay...
What's this!? ...Everyone, be careful, something's approaching!
Whaddya mean? Who the heck shows up when we've got our hands full!?
My, my, seems the Londo Bell lot slipped in here too.
Doesn't matter. Our mission is to seize the core unit
of this Devil Gundam thing that conquered the colony.
However many insects we kill along the way doesn't matter.
The Devil Gundam's core unit... So you're after Rain!?
Come to think of it, I heard its core unit uses a living being.
Doesn't matter who it is.
We space pirates just take whatever we want.
Like hell!! I won't hand Rain over to you... or anyone!
Flash, Burst! Stop helping the Bunker already!
Oh, you're here, Roll Kran. We joined the Bunker by choice, you know?
...While you were dead the first time...!
I'll kill you once more...!
Wh-What? What does that mean!? ...Roll?
Killed... once before!?
That's right... Roll Kran, hero of planet Latesia's resistance...
We, his comrades, killed him.
No way... Then why is Roll...!?
Because it was so stupid, wasn't it?
Freedom, justice, whatever you say, you could never beat the Bunker.
So we killed Roll, the resistance leader,
and made him out to be a coward who ran away.
How despicable...! Unforgivable!
You bastards... are way too evil!
Looks like we have to beat these guys and destroy the reactor too.
Heh heh... The space pirates of the Bunker, is it?
But even space pirates are powerless
before DG Cells, as I'll show you!
Along with Londo Bell, become sacrifices to the Devil Gundam!
Tch! The Bunker and the Devil Gundam's forces...
We can't let either of them have their way!
Treat them all as enemies! Intercept!
Easy for you to say...
But no matter whose hands the Devil Gundam ends up in,
Earth will be destroyed, that's for sure!
Whoa, what a free-for-all.
It's a total mess!
Burst!
Ngh...! Getting in our way again...
Burst! Wake up already!
...Heh heh, how naive, Roll Kran. I'll have my revenge for this!
Tch... She got away...
Burst...
Roll...
Flash! Stop this already!
Flash, leave the rest to me.
Roll... You'll pay for this! I'll tear you all limb from limb...!
Damn...! Flash...
Roll, we're still in combat! Don't space out!
Dr. Kasshu! What did you mean by stopping Rain!?
Well, that is...
Wait...! Where the Grand-whatever was... something's coming out!
Is that... a robot?
What the... There's a Gundam stuck on top of a giant face...
That's... It's...!!
Dr. Kasshu, what is that Gundam...?
N-No... I can't believe it... But if this is the Devil Gundam's
final form, things have gotten terribly out of hand!
Look! On that Gundam...
Rain! I see, you can't get out on your own?
...Then I'll smash this thing!
Stop, Domon!!
Wh-Why!? Father!?
Look closely! ...That Gundam is Rain herself!
Wh... What did you say?
Domon, think about it...
Why the Devil Gundam's evolution suddenly accelerated!
But... why!?
Listen, Domon... Rain is avoiding you!!
What...!?
(It's my father who's made you suffer... and his sin is my sin...
I'm sorry, Domon. We'll never meet again...)
...That can't beeee!!
Nooo! Don't come near meee!!
Now you see... This Gundam runs on human emotion and the psyche,
the ultimate final form! And it is Rain herself...!
S-Something like that can be built...?
It's not about theory... The real thing is right in front of us. That's all.
Dr. Kasshu... What a frightening talent...
No... After coming this far, the final enemy is... you, Rain...!
Domon! Are you all right with that!?
Don't give up.
That's right, Domon. Weren't you going to save Rain?
Why can't you understand how Rain feels?
Listen. The man who hurt the one she loves was her own father...
Deep in her heart, Rain is full of guilt toward you...
That's why she shut her heart away inside that Gundam...
So! I'll teach you a spell that's sure to open the door to her heart...
...It's just three words: "I love you."
Huh...?
Hey... Have you ever told Rain you love her?
N-No...
Then all you have to do is be honest about your own feelings, Domon.
B-But...
Come on! Get on with it already, Domon Kasshu!
...If you really care about her... isn't it simple?
There's no need to hold back for anyone's sake, Domon.
I could force-cut every unit's comms from here, if you like.
That would disrupt the chain of command... We can't do that.
See, everyone gets it! Go get her!!
...Or else... I won't ever be able to love anyone but you...!
Allenby...
Hehe... Now hurry!
Thank you...
All units, cover Domon!
Roger!
Quite the spectacle, huh?
We can't exactly not help out, can we?
Seems so. ...We'll need to keep anyone else from butting in, though...
RAAAAAIN!!
...I-It stopped...
The Devil Colony's activity has stopped...
Now comes the real test...
Rain, can you hear me, Rain...? You don't have to answer.
Just listen...
Mr. Mikamura saved us... He saved my father.
...He said all of it was his fault.
Rain's crying...
But none of that matters anymore! It's all right...
...Or do you think I'll blame you for it?
Hey... What have we been doing all this time?
What did everything we've done mean?
...We haven't found any answers yet...
Ugh, this is taking forever. Just hurry up and...
Shhhhh!
Sure, I've managed to win every battle so far.
But it's all thanks to you always being right there by my side...
That's right, those victories were won by you and me together.
So we have to stay together from now on, or it'll all mean nothing!!
I'm a clumsy man who knows nothing but fighting.
So this is the only way I can say it... I... you... I...
Uh... Ah... Ah... Do... mo...
I LOOOOVE YOU!! I NEED YOU!
RAAAAAIN!!
DOMOOOOON!!
Rain!
Domon! I'm sorry... But I'll never leave you again!
I won't let you go! Ever...!
We'll be together forever!
Well done, Domon...!
Hmm... Not bad, for you.
...How lovely...
Geez, it's making even us watching feel embarrassed...
But it's lovely. So honest...
With the loss of its bio-unit, the Devil Gundam's activity is...
...rapidly accelerating...!
Huh!?
B-But why?!
Allow me to explain.
...The DG Cells are rapidly rebuilding its tissue to keep the host alive.
What a wonderful, and what a terrifying invention...
...I am totally, overwhelmingly moved right now! I wish Akito and I...
...I'm still a child.
(But... that might be kind of nice.)
Now, Rain, let's finish this!
Yes!
COME FORTH!!
SHIIIINING GUNDAAAAM!
Domon... We did it...
Yeah... This time, it's really over...
Sekiha Love Love Tenkyoken usable.
I can't believe it... They actually beat that Devil Gundam...
Londo Bell... They're an opponent we can't take lightly...
...The Devil Gundam has gone completely silent.
The DG Cells infesting the colony are also starting to collapse.
Yay! Congratulations, Domon... and Rain!
Thank you... Allenby.
Yeah... This is all thanks to Mr. Mikamura, my father...
...and everyone who supported us...!
We did it, milady!
Yes, we defeated that monster.
Dr. Kasshu...
...It's all right. That was not the Ultimate Gundam I created.
It truly was a spawn of the devil... a Devil Gundam...
I've fought all kinds of enemies until now...
...but that's the first one as big as a colony.
True. Without the help of Dr. Kasshu... and Dr. Mikamura,
it might have been touch and go.
Well, Neo Japan's safe too, so I guess all's well that ends well.
All right, all units, return! The fighting isn't over yet.
...The Bunker... Flash, Burst...!
Roll... Is there no way... to reach an understanding with them...?
Drop it, Mia. ...Neither side can back down now...
Whew, what a free-for-all, and a little embarrassing too.
...Oh my? Kyosuke?
(Such enormous power was at work, yet they never appeared... Why?)
